description: White canvas; grey rounded box upper with small serif text "What would the world's largest cities be like if the land masses were rotated by 90 degrees?"; black-ink blackboard frame middle with one grey globe on a stand at left of board; stick figure lower-left holding a sheet of paper, hand on hip.
Single sample frame: arrow and second rotated globe (right of first) present on board; onset within 1 frame so exact appearance mechanism UNRESOLVED; first globe and figure unchanged.
Same as G0001 plus right-pointing arrow and a second globe (landmasses turned) on the blackboard; question box and stick figure unchanged.

Hard cut from blackboard scene to full-width flat coloured world map (green land, beige desert, light-blue ice, grey ocean) in a band mid-canvas with white above and below; labels ASIA AFRICA NORTH AMERICA unreadable-small then grow; map zooms/pans in with motion blur until NORTH AMERICA fills tile with ASIA and EUROPE upper.

Map close-up: ASIA and EUROPE upper in hand-lettered caps, NORTH AMERICA centre-left; light-blue ice with black mountain marks along lower coast; grey ocean strip at bottom, white below. No city labels.
Label "MEXICO CITY" with small magenta dot appears at lower-left on the ice coast; single activity frame.
Map with "MEXICO CITY" label and magenta dot lower-left, NORTH AMERICA, ASIA, EUROPE labels; white strip at bottom.
White circle vignette with black-ink line drawing of an ornate building (snow on roof) appears left of NORTH AMERICA above Mexico City label.
Map with Mexico City label and circular vignette of a building drawn in black ink inside a white circle, left-centre.

Canvas pans fast (motion blur) from North America across Asia to the far east; circular vignette slides off bottom-left; ends on JAKARTA label with magenta dot near top-left of tile, AUSTRALIA labelled green landmass lower-left, ice along top, white above.
Map centred on "JAKARTA" (dot, upper-left) with "AUSTRALIA" green/beige landmass left; ice and grey ocean upper; white strip at top.

Fast pan from Jakarta up/across Asia; ends on KOLKATA label at top with ice region below; "DE" then "DELHI" letters appear below-right of Kolkata (typing-like letter-by-letter label, f345 shows "DE"); ASIA EUROPE AFRI labels lower.
Map of northern Asia with labels KOLKATA and DELHI (magenta dots), ASIA, EUROPE, AFRI(CA) cropped right; ice light-blue; white strip at top.

Canvas zooms out/pans: more of map revealed, HONG KONG label appears left of Delhi (small, unreadable-small in early frames), NORTH AMERICA enters lower-left; ends with wider view, ASIA EUROPE NORTH AMERICA visible.
Wide map: KOLKATA, DELHI, HONG KONG labels with magenta dots; ASIA, EUROPE, NORTH AMERICA, cropped AF at right; ice along north.
Label "MAN" then "MANILA" appears letter by letter at far left (f453 "MAN", f456 "MANILA"); map static.
Wide map with labels MANILA, HONG KONG, KOLKATA, DELHI; no other new elements.
Label appears at right of Delhi letter by letter: "KAR" (f464) then "KARACHI" (f468); map static.
Wide map with MANILA, HONG KONG, KOLKATA, DELHI, KARACHI labels with magenta dots.
Label "MUM" (f476) then "MUMBAI" (f479) appears at right edge above KARACHI; map static.
Wide map with labels MANILA, HONG KONG, KOLKATA, DELHI, MUMBAI, KARACHI; ASIA EUROPE NORTH AMERICA; ice north.

Canvas zooms out then pans so full band of world is shown, white above and below; new labels appear during move: MEXICO CITY (f613 bottom), then at f624 SEOUL OSAKA TOKYO SHANGHAI BEIJING LOS ANGELES, at f627 MOSCOW CAIRO LONDON NEW YORK CITY; AFRICA and SOUTH AMERICA labelled; exact onset frame per label UNRESOLVED (sampled every 3 frames).
Whole-world map band, all city labels with magenta dots: KOLKATA MUMBAI KARACHI DELHI HONG KONG SHANGHAI SEOUL OSAKA TOKYO BEIJING MOSCOW CAIRO LONDON LOS ANGELES NEW YORK CITY MEXICO CITY; no marks.
Red oval outline appears around SEOUL label at left; single activity frame.
Map with red oval around SEOUL only.
Red oval appears around OSAKA label below Seoul; single frame.
Red ovals around SEOUL and OSAKA.
Red oval appears around TOKYO; single frame.
Red ovals around SEOUL OSAKA TOKYO.
Red oval appears around SHANGHAI (oval sits over green land); single frame.
Red ovals around SEOUL OSAKA TOKYO SHANGHAI.
Red oval appears around NEW YORK CITY label at lower-right of centre; single frame.
Map with five red ovals: SEOUL OSAKA TOKYO SHANGHAI NEW YORK CITY.

Canvas zooms in/pans toward east Asia and North America; red ovals visible at start (f850 to f853, fading) and absent by f858; labels remain with magenta dots; ends at larger scale with HONG KONG SHANGHAI SEOUL OSAKA TOKYO BEIJING MOSCOW and LOS ANGELES NEW YORK; oval removal frame UNRESOLVED.
Zoomed map, Asia upper and North America lower; city labels without red ovals.
Fast pan with motion blur eastward/rightward across Eurasia to Cairo area; ends with DELHI MUMBAI KARACHI MOSCOW CAIRO LONDON NEW YORK CITY and SAO PAULO at right; white band at top.
Map centred on Africa and Middle East: labels DELHI MUMBAI KARACHI MOSCOW CAIRO NILE LONDON NEW YORK CITY SAO PAULO; green land south of Cairo.
White circle vignette appears left of Cairo, black-ink drawing of a beach/palm-tree coastal scene with a sun; single frame.
Map with circular vignette of a shoreline scene (palms, sun, water) left of Cairo; labels as G0037.

Fast pan with motion blur toward South America; the circular vignette moves with the map and slides off left; ends on SAO PAULO and BUENOS AIRES labels (dots) on a beige/green landmass with ice at bottom; white at top then bottom.
Map close on SAO PAULO and BUENOS AIRES labels with magenta dots; South America; Africa upper-left; grey ocean bottom, white below; no vignette.
Fast blurred pan up and left across Africa/Asia then to North America; ends with MOSCOW and Asian cities at top, LOS ANGELES NEW YORK C(ITY) LONDON MEXICO CITY labelled, white band at bottom.
Map with Asia upper, North America lower: labels HONG KONG SHANGHAI SEOUL OSAKA TOKYO BEIJING MOSCOW LONDON LOS ANGELES NEW YORK C MEXICO CITY; white strip at bottom.
Small white cloud shapes with black outline appear just above LOS ANGELES label near the mountains; single frame.
Same map with small white clouds above LOS ANGELES (a few cloud shapes).
Pan/zoom with motion blur toward Eurasia and Africa; clouds near LA pan out; ends with KOLKATA DELHI MUMBAI KARACHI MOSCOW CAIRO LONDON NEW YORK CITY visible, ice region north, white top.
Map with labels KOLKATA DELHI MUMBAI KARACHI MOSCOW CAIRO LONDON NEW YORK CITY BEIJING; no vignette.
Continuous zoom in (scale increases, labels and dots grow) towards Moscow/London area; ends with large MOSCOW CAIRO LONDON NEW YORK CITY DELHI MUMBAI KARACHI.
Zoomed map: DELHI MUMBAI KARACHI MOSCOW CAIRO LONDON NEW YORK CITY large hand-lettered labels with magenta dots; no vignette.

White circle vignette appears over map between Moscow and London containing tiny black-ink drawing of two stick-figure/animal characters at a table (unreadable at tile scale; small text above); single frame.
Same map with circular vignette of two small characters at a table between MOSCOW and LONDON; held to end.
